d: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. While Brad counts the hours till he can escape the onslaught of crazy relatives, Kate begins to wonder about her own choices and ponders whether her family members are so crazy after all.
A man makes a deal with a mischievous elf who casts a magic spell that brings the 12 Days of Christmas to life.
The staff go into frantic speculation after accidentally discovering a list of their names in a notebook belonging to the mysterious new CEO.
The Scranton branch staff are challenged to double their sales; Andy decides to create an incentive program, but might end up regretting his promise.
After the warehouse employees win the lottery and quit their jobs, everyone in the office fantasizes about winning big; Darryl and Andy look for new warehouse workers.
Ross tries to win back Rachel's job with her former fashion employer; Phoebe tries to keep Joey from learning about his agent's death; Monica and Chandler make a horrifying discovery.

st: The One With Rachel's Going Away Party
d: One of the guys becomes offended when Rachel does not give him the same goodbye she gives the others.
The six friends prepare to say goodbye and embark on the next chapters of their lives; momentous events and last-minute surprises.

st: The One Where Monica Gets a Roommate
d: Monica's high-school friend visits after leaving her fiancé at the altar.

st: The One With the Sonogram at the End
d: Monica begins to feel the heat when she prepares dinner for her parents (Elliott Gould, Christina Pickles).
Monica finds it difficult to break up with her latest boyfriend (Geoffrey Lower), whom everyone likes; Chandler starts smoking again; Phoebe receives a large sum of money.
While the men attend a hockey game and end up at a hospital, the women spy on President Clinton's top aide, George Stephanopoulos, who lives across the street.

st: The One With the East German Laundry Detergent
d: Chandler and Phoebe plan to dump dates on the same night at the same coffee house.
An agent (June Gable) offers Joey a movie role as Al Pacino's naked body double; Chandler dates a liberal woman (Sofia Milos).
Chandler finds himself trapped in an ATM vestibule with model Jill Goodacre during a city-wide power failure.

st: The One Where Nana Dies Twice
d: Monica and Ross share their feelings about death and their grandmother.

The Jokers play unprofessional actors in a fake commercial then make wild assumptions about other mall goers; one Joker breaks and is tasked with becoming the strictest security guard imaginable in his punishment.

The Jokers hit the grocery store aisles dressed in absurd disguises, then train someone in using aggressive phone tactics for charity donations; the losing Joker must subject themselves to scientific probing into their hidden emotions.

The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York Pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review. Then, the losing joker is in for a punishment that really sucks.

The Jokers hatch horrible revenge schemes on their office bullies, then put one poor contractor through the wringer as they attempt home improvement projects; tonight's loser will be gifted the world's finest douchemobile.

st: The One Where Underdog Gets Away
d: Monica and Ross cook Thanksgiving dinner for themselves, but everyone else shows up.
The friends renege on a promise not to bring dates to their New Year's Eve party.
Chandler learns details about his mother's (Morgan Fairchild) life when she appears on national television.

st: The One With the Dozen Lasagnas
d: Rachel's Italian boyfriend tries to seduce Phoebe; Rachel accidentally reveals a secret to Ross; Monica's aunt refuses to take the lasagnas she ordered.
Phoebe's psychiatrist boyfriend (Fisher Stevens) annoys her friends with his analyses of their lives.

st: The One With the Candy Hearts
d: It's Valentine's Day and, out on his first date in nine years, Ross meets up with his ex-wife; Monica, Phoebe and Rachel rebel against the spirit of the day by burning mementos of past relationships.

st: The One With the Stoned Guy
d: A "high-spirited" restaurant owner wolfs down the gourmet meal Monica created as part of a job interview.
Joey asks Phoebe's sister (Lisa Kudrow in a dual role) on a date; Ross takes Lamaze classes with Carol (Jane Sibbett) and Susan (Jessica Hecht).

Kripke has proof that Dr. Pemberton plagiarized his thesis in college, and Sheldon and Amy aren't sure if they should turn him in or not; Wolowitz learns that Bernadette wasn't the only waitress at the Cheesecake Factory who had a crush on him.

Leonard is pleasantly surprised when Beverly comes to visit, and she's genuinely kind to him, until he finds out the real reason she's there; Denise and Stuart overstay their welcome at the Wolowitz house.
Sheldon and Amy await big news.

Bernadette and Wolowitz leave their kids for the first time; Penny and Leonard try to keep a secret; Sheldon and Amy stick together; Koothrappali makes a new friend; the gang travels together into an uncharted future.
Leonard is happy to meet new neighbor Penny, but his roommate thinks he is chasing an impossible dream.
Leonard volunteers to sign for a package, hoping to make a good impression on Penny.
Unhappy to learn that Penny is seeing someone, Leonard summons the courage to ask another woman on a date.
Getting fired gives Sheldon the opportunity to explore life beyond physics, but when he spends his time weaving ponchos and acting like a shut-in, Leonard calls Sheldon's mother for assistance.
Leonard, realizing his pursuit of Penny is fruitless, has an unexpected encounter with a fellow scientist (Sara Gilbert).
Leonard, Sheldon, Wolowitz and Koothrappali attend Penny's Halloween party.
Penny sleeps on Leonard and Sheldon's couch when Wolowitz seduces her friend and takes over her apartment; in need of a fourth member, the guys ask Penny to join their "Halo" team.
On a blind date, Koothrappali discovers that he can talk to the opposite sex after a few drinks, but his date takes an interest in Sheldon.
Penny tries to mediate when Sheldon and Leonard disagree on whether to present their joint findings at a physics conference.
Leonard and Sheldon try to avoid seeing Penny perform after hearing her sing, but the elaborate lie Sheldon tells leads to an unexpected result.
Leonard and the boys avoid Sheldon when he gets sick, leaving Penny to nurse him back to health.
When Andy decides to throw a garden party at Schrute Farms to impress Robert, Dwight researches how to be a good host; Andy's family makes him feel self-conscious.
Erin tries to put on a Halloween party that will please both Andy and Robert California; Jim and Pam fight about the existence of ghosts; Dwight bonds with Robert California's son.
Dwight installs a device in the office that will get everyone fired if they make too many errors; Gabe takes a liking to an employee at the warehouse.
Pam teams up with Dwight to prove that Jim thinks her temporary replacement is pretty; Robert California asks to join Andy, Darryl and Kevin's band.
Andy tries to motivate the staff by taking them on a field trip to Gettysburg; Robert asks those who stay behind to come up with the company's next big idea.
Robert California brings his wife (Maura Tierney) into the office to find her a job; Dwight opens a gym in the building.
Andy tries to make holiday wishes come true; Robert decides to drown his sorrows at the office party.

Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush.
The unexpected visit of a mysterious person from Harriette's past leaves Carl speechless.
Carl wants a promotion; Lt. Murtaugh wants to date Rachel.

st: A Fancy Article and a Scholarship for a Baby
d: Sheldon's published paper leads to a frenzy of grad school recruiting; Georgie tries to speak more properly in front of his daughter.

st: Community Service and the Key to a Happy Marriage
d: Meemaw gets assigned a tough probation officer; Georgie takes marriage advice from his father-in-law.

st: A Little Snip and Teaching Old Dogs
d: George Sr. is worried that Mary wants another baby and gets a vasectomy behind her back; Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis go to Sheldon for science tutoring.

st: A New Home and a Traditional Texas Torture
d: George Sr. gets an exciting job offer; Sheldon prepares for his move to California.
Sheldon leaves East Texas for the California Institute of Technology following the death of his father, George Cooper Sr.

Young Sheldon ends its seven-year run with a must-see two-episode series finale; Jim Parsons and Mayim Bialik reprise their roles as Sheldon Cooper and Amy Farrah Fowler in an unforgettable hour of television.
Monica takes Rachel to the hospital; Ross asks his dad (Elliott Gould) for advice on becoming a father.

st: The One With All the Poker
d: When the girls lose money to the guys in a poker match they seek out Monica's Aunt Iris, a famous card player, for lessons and then demand a rematch.

st: The One Where the Monkey Gets Away
d: Rachel accidentally lets Ross' pet monkey escape, and the friends form a search party; she is then horrified to learn that her former best friend is engaged to her ex-fiance.

st: The One With the Evil Orthodontist
d: Rachel is asked to be the maid of honor in her ex-fiance's (Mitchell Whitfield) wedding.

st: The One With the Fake Monica
d: Monica, Rachel and Phoebe go on a covert operation to track down the woman who stole Monica's credit card.

st: The One With the Ick Factor
d: Monica's new boyfriend (Stan Kirsch) exposes his own secret after she admits her true age.
When Carol gives birth, Ross and Susan almost miss the event; Joey befriends an unmarried pregnant woman.

st: The One Where Rachel Finds Out
d: Rachel discovers Ross' feelings for her when he goes out of town on a business trip.

st: The One With Ross' New Girlfriend
d: Rachel decides to look up her former boyfriend (Cosimo Fusco) when she is distraught over Ross' new girlfriend (Lauren Tom).

st: The One With the Breast Milk
d: While tending his son, Ross expresses his displeasure when Phoebe tastes Carol's breast milk to check the temperature.
Monica and Rachel's grumpy downstairs neighbor (Larry Hankin) dies and leaves all his belongings to the girls.
The group is amazed when Phoebe marries a Canadian ice dancer (Steve Zahn) to help him get his green card.
Sheldon and Leonard look for a way to derail a 15-year-old physics prodigy's research.
When Sheldon tries to prove his mental superiority as they train for the Physics Bowl, the guys kick him off the team and bring his nemesis (Sara Gilbert) aboard.
Leonard and the guys buy a time machine prop from a classic movie; Penny tells the guys their obsession with comics and toys is pathetic.
Penny learns that Leonard does not celebrate birthdays, so she plans a surprise party; Sheldon unexpectedly gets to live out one of his biggest fantasies in an electronics store.
When Leonard finally works up the courage to ask Penny out on a date, they each turn to Sheldon for advice.
Penny's first date with Leonard goes awry; Penny finds Sheldon to be an unwilling confidant.
After seeing Penny with a handsome new guy, Leonard rushes into a rebound relationship with Sheldon's nemesis, Leslie Winkle.
Sheldon creates a monster when he introduces Penny to online gaming.
Raj gets an inflated ego and makes a play for Penny after being referenced in a magazine article.
Leonard and his friends stage an intervention to force Sheldon to face his fear of driving.

Pro skater and actor Sunny Suljic joins forces with skate-world legend Jesse Sebastiani to trap pro skater Alex Midler in a car-boot meltdown, while Anthony Davis sends NBA defensive stopper Daniel Gafford into a blood donation campaign.
Former pro boxer Floyd Mayweather teams up with Anthony Davis to drag NBA star coach Tyronn Lue into a charity cookout.

NBA star forward Tristan Thompson sends NBA superstar guard Darius Garland into an art auction disaster, and Anthony Davis sets up NFL defensive lineman Osa Odighizuwa for a business meeting interrupted by a streaker.

The Jokers are back pretending to be overnight watchmen who don't know when to call it quits, before rallying bystanders to take their side in an unlawful arrest; but one loser has to face a punishment that brings out his feminine side.

Sal, Q and Murr kick off another season of antics by getting themselves stuck in a vent system and confusing customers at a bagel shop; our losing Joker will face humiliation in a punishment that's tough to swallow.
The Jokers are back working as dry cleaners and TV producers, but one of them can't keep it together and must endure concertgoers who have escaped their enclosures.
Andy gets the office involved in a trivia contest; Dwight explores job opportunities at Sabre headquarters.
When Robert decides to sell his mansion, Kevin suggests he throw a pool party for the office; Erin flirts with Dwight to get Andy's attention; Robert gives a tour of his home.
